reading = "".join(str(d) for d in probs.argmax(axis=1))
print(reading, probs.max(axis=1).round(2))

    tf.keras.Input(shape=(16, 16)),
    layers.Flatten(),
    layers.Dense(16, activation="relu"),
    layers.Dense(10, activation="softmax"),
])
